UnitStatement: The release quality gates checklist routes release-impacting changes through software-quality gates.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-RELEASE-QUALITY-GATES -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: The checklist covers solver changes, rule-engine changes, GUI releases, report-template releases, and mixed changes.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-RELEASE-QUALITY-GATES -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: The checklist is not a professional engineering approval, code-compliance ruling, legal opinion, release publication authorization, or CI implementation.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-RELEASE-QUALITY-GATES -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: The checklist defines evidence that maintainers must collect or explicitly waive before a release label is considered.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-RELEASE-QUALITY-GATES -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: Every release-impacting change must be routed to all applicable gate families.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-RELEASE-QUALITY-GATES -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: Changes to solver mechanics, loads, stress recovery, units, diagnostics, or result envelopes route to the Solver gate.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-RELEASE-QUALITY-GATES -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: Changes to rule schema, expression evaluation, completeness, or rule-pack lifecycle route to the Rule-engine gate.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-RELEASE-QUALITY-GATES -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: Changes to model editing, solve workflow, warning display, or results viewing route to the GUI gate.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-RELEASE-QUALITY-GATES -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: Changes to public report templates, export fields, notices, or manifest data route to the Report-template gate.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-RELEASE-QUALITY-GATES -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: Any change spanning multiple gate families routes to the Mixed gate.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-RELEASE-QUALITY-GATES -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: Mixed changes run the union of applicable gates unless the human release authority records a waiver and risk disposition.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-RELEASE-QUALITY-GATES -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: Every gate record must include the change identifier, scope, affected packages, and owner.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-RELEASE-QUALITY-GATES -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: Every gate record must include the commands run and complete pass/fail results.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-RELEASE-QUALITY-GATES -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: Every gate record must include the source artifacts and generated outputs reviewed.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-RELEASE-QUALITY-GATES -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: Every gate record must include benchmark source/provenance and redistribution status where examples are public.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-RELEASE-QUALITY-GATES -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: Every gate record must include known limitations, open risks, and unresolved TBD items.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-RELEASE-QUALITY-GATES -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: Every gate record must include protected-content, private-data, and real-secret scan disposition.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-RELEASE-QUALITY-GATES -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: Every gate record must include a human governance acceptance or waiver record.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-RELEASE-QUALITY-GATES -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: Every gate record must include a statement that release evidence is software-quality evidence only.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-RELEASE-QUALITY-GATES -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: The Solver gate is used for changes to solver mechanics, load handling, stress recovery, units, diagnostics, or result envelopes.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-RELEASE-QUALITY-GATES -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: Solver gate evidence requires that applicable mechanics benchmarks pass.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-RELEASE-QUALITY-GATES -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: Solver gate evidence requires that applicable stress-recovery benchmarks pass.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-RELEASE-QUALITY-GATES -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: Solver gate evidence requires that applicable nonlinear support regression checks pass.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-RELEASE-QUALITY-GATES -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: Solver gate evidence requires unit/schema checks to pass where units or serialization are touched.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-RELEASE-QUALITY-GATES -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: Solver gate evidence requires diagnostics and warning/result-envelope behavior to be tested where affected.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-RELEASE-QUALITY-GATES -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: Solver gate evidence requires that the tolerance source is named, or the tolerance remains TBD.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-RELEASE-QUALITY-GATES -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: Solver gate evidence requires that numerical warnings, non-convergence, and missing result states remain visible.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-RELEASE-QUALITY-GATES -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: The Solver gate does not permit selecting final public release tolerances without a human governance record.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-RELEASE-QUALITY-GATES -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: The Solver gate does not permit claiming code compliance, certification, or professional acceptance.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-RELEASE-QUALITY-GATES -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: The Solver gate does not permit using protected standards examples or commercial benchmark files without documented rights.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-RELEASE-QUALITY-GATES -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: The Rule-engine gate is used for rule schemas, expression evaluation, rule-pack completeness, rule-pack lifecycle, or rule-result presentation.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-RELEASE-QUALITY-GATES -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: Rule-engine gate evidence requires deterministic evaluator tests to pass for invented examples.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-RELEASE-QUALITY-GATES -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: Rule-engine gate evidence requires required-input completeness checks to pass.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-RELEASE-QUALITY-GATES -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: Rule-engine gate evidence requires unit-aware rule checks to reject or flag incompatible units.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-RELEASE-QUALITY-GATES -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: Rule-engine gate evidence requires verifying sandboxing and arbitrary-code-execution boundaries where touched.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-RELEASE-QUALITY-GATES -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: Rule-engine gate evidence requires that rule-pack checksum and provenance fields are preserved.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-RELEASE-QUALITY-GATES -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: Rule-engine gate evidence requires that public fixtures use invented or redistributable data only.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-RELEASE-QUALITY-GATES -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: Rule-engine gate evidence requires pass/fail states to be described as user-rule computations, not professional authentication.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-RELEASE-QUALITY-GATES -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: The GUI gate is used for releases affecting model editing, property inspection, missing-data behavior, solve execution UX, warning display, or result viewing.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-RELEASE-QUALITY-GATES -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: GUI gate evidence requires that missing solve data, missing rule-check data, and missing provenance are visible to users.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-RELEASE-QUALITY-GATES -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: GUI gate evidence requires that warnings, assumptions, nonlinear uncertainty, and result-envelope states are not collapsed into generic success states.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-RELEASE-QUALITY-GATES -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: GUI gate evidence requires workflow tests or screenshots to be recorded where practical.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-RELEASE-QUALITY-GATES -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: GUI gate evidence requires that private data stays local and is not sent to unapproved services.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-RELEASE-QUALITY-GATES -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: GUI gate evidence requires that GUI labels avoid compliance, certification, endorsement, and professional approval claims.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-RELEASE-QUALITY-GATES -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: Final browser/device matrix, accessibility threshold, and screenshot tooling are TBD until governed by a release-policy decision.
Notes: Explicit TBD in source pending governance

UnitStatement: Report-template gate evidence requires that audit manifest and checksum fields remain stable or that changes are explained.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-RELEASE-QUALITY-GATES -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: Report-template gate evidence requires that warnings, assumptions, limitations, and rule-pack provenance remain visible.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-RELEASE-QUALITY-GATES -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: Report-template gate evidence requires that protected-content lint passes for public examples and templates.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-RELEASE-QUALITY-GATES -> CAT-020.

UnitStatement: Report-template gate evidence requires that professional-boundary notices are present.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-RELEASE-QUALITY-GATES -> CAT-020.

CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-RELEASE-QUALITY-GATES -> CAT-020.
